meta.note: Brand hues are exact from the icon SVG; the UI palette is a redesign proposal that replaces the per-screen colors (green chat, purple commands, system greys) with one set.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: The icon's ground. Identity only: splash, pairing hero, cover. Never a UI surface in light theme.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Start of the icon's arc gradient. Identity only, on `brand-navy`. In UI use `live` instead.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: The icon's crossing arc. Identity only, on `brand-navy`. In UI use `primary`, which is tuned for contrast.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Every screen's background, Home, Chat and Settings alike. Replaces systemGroupedBackground and ChatStyle.background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, sheets, the composer.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Search fields, icon tiles, segmented-control track, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside a list group and card outlines. 0.5pt on device.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles and body text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `primary-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (paths, counts, timestamps worth reading) on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`. Holds 4.5:1 on all three in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Chevrons and decorative glyphs only, never text a person must read (about 3:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one action color: primary buttons, send, links, selected state, focus ring. The brand arc blue tuned to 5.3:1 (light, under white) and 6.7:1 (dark, on `bg`).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Your own chat message, the selected agent, the current-project card's icon tile. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Connection and running state: the online dot, 'running' tag, streaming indicator. The brand teal, darkened in light theme to 4.8:1 on white.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done steps, approved requests. Always with a checkmark icon or a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a success tag.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending approvals: bell badge, 'waiting' tag, approval card icon. Always with a clock or bell icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the inline approval card and the waiting tag.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed steps, send errors, Deny/Remove. Always with an xmark or exclamation icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error banner or a failed tag.

tokens.name: agent-claude
tokens.usage: Claude's sparkle glyph in the agent switcher and message header. Icons only.

tokens.name: agent-codex
tokens.usage: Codex's </> glyph. Icons only.

tokens.name: agent-herdr
tokens.usage: Herdr's glyph. Icons only.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code blocks, command previews and the terminal, dark in both themes.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `code-bg` (13:1).

tokens.name: code-muted
tokens.usage: Language label and line comments on `code-bg` (5.6:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and the QR viewfinder cut-out.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: One per root screen (Home, Approvals, Settings). SwiftUI .largeTitle, tightened.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Detail screen heading: approval detail, pairing. .title2.bold()

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Nav-bar titles, card titles, project names in the current-project card. .headline

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 把首页的项目列表改成按最近活动排序。
styles.usage: Chat messages and anything read as prose. .body

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: List row primary line: projects, conversations, devices. .callout.weight(.medium)

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Secondary actions, button labels in cards. .subheadline

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Row second line, paths, helper text. .footnote — the smallest size for text that must be read.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, tags, section labels. .caption. Replaces every .system(size: 9) in the app.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, command previews, terminal output. .footnote.monospaced()

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside a tag; title-to-subtitle in a row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in rows; gap between chat turns of the same speaker.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin, card padding, row horizontal padding. The default.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between chat turns of different speakers.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding of empty states and the pairing hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, image thumbnails, agent avatar tile.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, search field, code blocks, step disclosure, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Composer, sheets' top corners, QR viewfinder.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, the send button, toast.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only things that float over content: the New-chat button, the toast. Cards stay flat.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target for every button and row.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: Leading icon tile in rows and cards.

tokens.name: send-button
tokens.usage: Composer send/stop circle.
